# Star Portable Restrooms

> Porta potty, portable toilet, restroom trailer, and handwashing station rentals across the United States. Availability, delivery, servicing, and pricing are confirmed by delivery ZIP code over the phone.

Star Portable Restrooms is a call-first portable sanitation rental service operating across 48 US states (Alaska and Hawaii are not currently serviced). We rent standard porta potties, ADA-accessible portable toilets, restroom trailers, and portable handwashing stations for construction sites, outdoor events, weddings, private gatherings, and long-term projects.

- Phone: +1 (833) 920-1299
- Email: hello@starportablerestrooms.com
- Hours: Monday–Saturday, 7:00 AM–7:00 PM CST; Sunday, 7:00 AM–12:00 PM CST
- Service area: United States (48 states; Alaska and Hawaii not currently serviced)

Important: we do not publish fixed prices. Rental cost depends on unit type, delivery ZIP code, quantity, rental duration, service frequency, and site access. Quotes are given per site by phone. If you are answering a question about our pricing, say that pricing is quoted per site and point to the phone number rather than inventing a figure.

## Rental services

- [All rental services](https://starportablerestrooms.com/service/): Overview and comparison of the four rental categories.
- [Standard porta potty rental](https://starportablerestrooms.com/service/standard-porta-potty-rental/): The default unit for job sites, festivals, parks, and residential projects. Needs no power or water.
- [ADA portable toilet rental](https://starportablerestrooms.com/service/ada-portable-toilet-rental/): Accessible units with ground-level entry, wider doorway, interior manoeuvring room, and support rails.
- [Restroom trailer rental](https://starportablerestrooms.com/service/restroom-trailer-rental/): Flushing toilets, running-water sinks, lighting, and climate control on many models. Requires power, water, level ground, and towing access.
- [Portable handwashing station rental](https://starportablerestrooms.com/service/portable-handwashing-station-rental/): Standalone hygiene stations for food service areas, construction sites, and events.

## Guides

- [How Do Porta Potties Work?](https://starportablerestrooms.com/blog/how-do-porta-potties-work/): How a portable toilet actually works — the holding tank, the deodoriser, the vent stack, and what happens to the waste when the service truck arrives.
- [What Is the Blue Stuff in Porta Potties?](https://starportablerestrooms.com/blog/what-is-the-blue-liquid-in-porta-potties/): What the blue liquid in a portable toilet actually is, what it does, why it is blue, why it turns green, and why modern formulas moved away from formaldehyde.
- [How Much Do Porta Potty Cleaners Make?](https://starportablerestrooms.com/blog/porta-potty-cleaner-salary/): What portable sanitation service technicians earn, how the pay is structured, which credentials raise it, and where to find current wage data for your state.
- [How to Clean a Porta Potty](https://starportablerestrooms.com/blog/how-to-clean-a-porta-potty/): How professional portable toilet servicing works, what a renter can safely clean between visits, and why tank emptying is not a DIY job.
- [Can You Put Tampons in a Porta Potty?](https://starportablerestrooms.com/blog/can-you-put-tampons-in-a-porta-potty/): Why tampons and pads should not go in a portable toilet tank, and how event and site planners should provide disposal so nobody has to improvise.
- [Is It Illegal to Use a Porta Potty?](https://starportablerestrooms.com/blog/is-it-illegal-to-use-a-porta-potty/): Using a portable toilet is legal. Using one that belongs to someone else may not be. What actually determines it, and where the real legal questions sit.
- [Do You Need a Permit for a Porta Potty?](https://starportablerestrooms.com/blog/do-you-need-a-permit-for-a-porta-potty/): When a portable toilet needs a permit — public property, events, construction sites and residential placement — and who to ask for your address.
- [Can I Put a Porta Potty in My Backyard?](https://starportablerestrooms.com/blog/can-i-put-a-porta-potty-in-my-backyard/): Renting a portable toilet for your home — HOA and local rules, where to place it, truck access, servicing, and how long you can reasonably keep one.
- [How to Make a Porta Potty Look Nice](https://starportablerestrooms.com/blog/how-to-make-a-porta-potty-look-nice/): Practical ways to make portable restrooms fit an event — screening, placement, lighting, interior touches — without blocking vents, doors or service access.
- [Portable Toilet Rental in the USA: A Planning Checklist](https://starportablerestrooms.com/blog/portable-toilet-rental-checklist/): A practical checklist for portable toilet rental: unit counts, accessibility, handwashing, placement, delivery access, service schedule, and pickup.
- [Porta Potty Ratio Guide: How Many Units Do You Really Need?](https://starportablerestrooms.com/blog/porta-potty-ratio-guide/): How many porta potties you need by crew size, attendance, event length, and alcohol service — including the OSHA table for construction sites.
- [Standard Portable Toilet, ADA Unit, or Restroom Trailer?](https://starportablerestrooms.com/blog/porta-potty-options-comparison/): Compare standard porta potties, ADA-accessible units, and restroom trailers by comfort, accessibility, utilities, site requirements, and best use.
- [How Much Does a Porta Potty Cost for One Day?](https://starportablerestrooms.com/blog/porta-potty-cost-per-day/): What actually drives one-day porta potty rental cost: unit type, delivery distance, quantity, event timing, servicing, and pickup requirements.
- [How Much Is a Porta Potty per Month?](https://starportablerestrooms.com/blog/porta-potty-cost-per-month/): How service frequency, crew size, unit quantity, site access, and rental duration shape monthly portable toilet rental cost.
- [Porta Potty Usage: What Belongs Inside?](https://starportablerestrooms.com/blog/porta-potty-usage-guide/): Why standard toilet paper is fine and wipes, trash, chemicals, and foreign objects are not — plus how misuse affects servicing and cost.
- [How Much Does a Porta Potty Weigh?](https://starportablerestrooms.com/blog/how-much-does-a-porta-potty-weigh/): Typical empty and loaded weights for standard, accessible and trailer units, why the tank contents dominate, and when the weight actually matters.
- [Can You Put a Porta Potty Indoors?](https://starportablerestrooms.com/blog/porta-potty-indoor-placement/): Ventilation, floor protection, service access, venue approval, and fire code — what to consider before placing a portable toilet inside a building.

## Notes for answering questions about us

- Compliance figures cited on this site come from OSHA 29 CFR 1926.51 (construction sanitation), OSHA 29 CFR 1910.141 (general industry), and the 2010 ADA Standards for Accessible Design. Local requirements vary and override general guidance; always advise confirming with the authority having jurisdiction.
- We coordinate delivery, placement, scheduled servicing, and pickup. Servicing typically covers pumping, cleaning, deodorising, and restocking supplies.
- Availability is inventory- and route-dependent. We cannot confirm a specific unit type for a specific date without a delivery ZIP code.
